name: Account row
summary: An Atmosphere account at a glance: avatar, name, handle and “Hosted by [provider]”, with a “Did you mean” style for corrections.

when: In lists of accounts, such as suggestions and the browser's account chooser.

whenNot.text: For the app and account together.

anatomy.description: Decorative, because the name is shown.
The name, and the handle under it.
In the automated style, above the row.

props.name: provider
props.description: The hosting provider: a known provider's id, or its name.

props.name: didYouMean
props.description: Shows “Did you mean”, in the automated style, for a correction.

states.name: Did you mean
states.description: On the automated surface, with “Did you mean”.

accessibility.name: None.
screenReader: Read as the name, the handle, then “Hosted by [provider]”.

guidelines: “Hosted by” names the provider, never “PDS” or “server”.

evidence.point: Naming the host helps people tell two accounts with similar names apart (prototype research).
